items.q: What did a SUALab customer tell Joseph Lee about AI?
items.a: **I don't care if you use AI.** I want my **job done**. AI is a medium. Trend-raise without a value prop is about a **two-year** runway, then danger.
2015 post-AlphaGo manufacturing inspection. Fashion first (no network, **~500** Korea calls) then factories. **5×** yearly growth, **3 years** to first revenue, sold **$200M** in 2019.

items.q: How did they sell with no product?
items.a: CEO + CTO, laptop + one-pager. **Three months** to prove from scratch. Fail = free. Win = **pay what you think it's worth**. **3 of 4** paid.

items.q: How do you find the hair-on-fire problem?
items.a: Ask what success looks like this year. Start with **~5** bullets. **~10** customers → 3. **~1,500** → 1 common pain. Trust first (meetups/training); they will not tell you the real problem cold.

items.q: What do you sell in week four, and where does the first output live?
items.a: Sell **yourself**, not a buggy app — you cannot outbid a 20-year incumbent. First output in **Looker / their support stack**. Own dashboard only after they felt the value. Co-founder = decade fit, same priority, complementary A/B.
